# Game Idea

**Title:** Canvas Runner
**Genre:** Endless runner (HTML Canvas)
**Core Loop:** Player controls a small rectangle that moves left/right to dodge incoming obstacle blocks that scroll down the screen. Collect points by passing obstacles.
**Lose Condition:** Collision with any obstacle or falling off the bottom of the canvas triggers a game over.
